_what: ACCOUNT-KEYED CENTRAL REAPER — the one thing in the repo that destroys Vast hosts on a narrow, provably-safe predicate, keyed on the account so no lane's private teardown bug can leave a box billing. RULE 1: terminal state, unconditional. RULE 2: unit recorded done AND its output verified present in the object store, attributed to THIS rental by timestamp. Nothing else may destroy.
never_reaps_on: a `done` record older than the instance

reap.label: selcal-smarca4-m3-r1
reap.why: actual_status='running' cur_state='stopped' is TERMINAL (derived set: ['error', 'exited', 'offline', 'stopped']). A terminal host is not coming back, so anything it produced is already in the object store or was never written — THIS RULE CANNOT LOSE WORK BY CONSTRUCTION. It still appears in `GET /instances/`, and a host cannot end its own rental (§6: only the control plane can), so it persists until something destroys it. Nothing did: the owning lane's `mode=reap` ran, exited SUCCESS, and destroyed neither this nor a finished host.
